name: agent-runtime-map-workspace
description: Turn your codebase into an evidence-backed Agent Runtime Map.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @agent-runtime-map/schema && npm run build -w @agent-runtime-map/analysis-kit && npm run build -w @agent-runtime-map/project-reader && npm run build -w @agent-runtime-map/react && npm run build -w @agent-runtime-map/typescript && npm run build -w @agent-runtime-map/python && npm run build -w @agent-runtime-map/logic-compiler && npm run build -w @agent-runtime-map/semantic && npm run build -w @agent-runtime-map/core && npm run build -w @agent-runtime-map/mcp && npm run build -w @agent-runtime-map/viewer && npm run build -w agent-runtime-map
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm audit --audit-level=high && node scripts/check-package.mjs
